integrity: Full algebraic proof and standalone exact-support finite-field checks; dense numerical singular-value check at the smallest split field. No independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Odd prime p at least five, two-dimensional prime-field space, fixed nonzero quadratic-form coefficient d, unweighted norm-one conic indicator, complete Weyl orbit.
Describes complex linear-lifting spectrum and Weyl kernel, not injectivity of nonlinear phase retrieval on pure signals.
Kloosterman singular bands are exactly specified finite character sums; no universal elementary closed form or minimum singular bound is claimed.
Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Exact Gabor tomography rank and singular spectrum for prime-plane quadratic conics
